# Kevin D Gonzalez · Professional Photography | R59 Media

> Official photography portfolio and creative services by Kevin D Gonzalez at R59 Media. Specializing in studio portraits, on-location portraiture, private and corporate event coverage, and editorial visual storytelling.

- [Pricing](https://software-engineering-project.r59mediatesting.workers.dev/#pricing): Transparent session packages, investment options, and instant booking estimate calculator.
